note: Workable job questions for the stand-in hiring system (tools/mock-ats.py) and tools/test-ats-workable.py. Shaped like GET https://{subdomain}.workable.com/spi/v3/jobs/{shortcode}/questions in Workable's API reference (workable.readme.io/reference/job-questions): questions[] {id, body, type (free_text, short_text, multiple_choice, boolean, dropdown, numeric, date, file), required, single_answer, choices[] {id, body}, supported_file_types, max_file_size}. Written by hand from that reference, not recorded from a live employer: the questions need the employer's token.

questions.body: Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?
How did you hear about this job?
How many years of experience do you have?
What is your favorite color and why?
